# dockerfile

## Install

Add `rules_dx` to `MODULE.bazel`:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<version>")
```

Load the rules from `@rules_dx//dockerfile:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//dockerfile:defs.bzl", "dockerfile_library")
```

## Rules

### `dockerfile_library`

Owns the Dockerfiles of one package for dx lint (hadolint).

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `srcs` | `label_list` | no | Dockerfiles of this package: Dockerfile, Containerfile, Dockerfile.*, Containerfile.*, *.Dockerfile, *.dockerfile, *.Containerfile or *.containerfile. |
| `deps` | `label_list` | no | Other Dockerfile libraries this package depends on. |
